name: Exp_CandleTrend
summary: This EA generates trading signals based on a simple candlestick trend pattern: it opens a buy position when a configurable number of consecutive bullish candles appear, and a sell position when the same number of consecutive bearish candles appear. It includes stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.
summary_zh: 该EA基于简单的K线趋势形态生成交易信号：当出现指定数量的连续阳线时开多仓，当出现相同数量的连续阴线时开空仓。它包含止损、止盈功能，并通过TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于连续同向K线的趋势确认，认为连续N根阳线代表强势上涨趋势，连续N根阴线代表强势下跌趋势。入场条件为：当指定数量（CandleTrendTotal，默认3）的K线全部为阳线时买入，全部为阴线时卖出。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000），同时在反向信号出现时允许平仓。仓位管理提供了五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损自由保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位比例（默认0.1），结合MMMode选择具体的计算方式。信号仅在指定时间周期的新K线形成时检测，避免重复计算，但SignalBar=0时每tick都会重新计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend confirmation via consecutive same-direction candles, assuming that N consecutive bullish candles indicate strong upward momentum and N consecutive bearish candles indicate strong downward momentum. Entry conditions: buy when all candles in the lookback window (CandleTrendTotal, default 3) are bullish (close > open), sell when all are bearish (close < open). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), with optional position closing on reverse signals enabled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing offers five modes: free margin share, balance share, loss-based free margin share, loss-based balance share, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter (default 0.1) to control position proportion, combined with MMMode to select the calculation method. Signal detection occurs only on new bars of the specified timeframe, preventing redundant calculations, though setting SignalBar=0 triggers recalculation on every tick.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数检测方法（自由保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation method (free margin/balance/loss share/fixed lot)

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions by indicator signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions by indicator signal

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
提供多种资金管理模式，灵活性较高
包含止损止盈设置，有基本的风险控制
使用IsNewBar机制避免重复信号，减少不必要的交易
支持独立的买卖开仓和平仓权限控制，灵活性好
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
Multiple money management modes providing good flexibility
Includes stop loss and take profit settings for basic risk control
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to avoid duplicate signals and reduce unnecessary trades
Supports independent buy/sell open and close permission controls for flexibility
cons: 策略过于简单，连续阳线/阴线并不一定代表趋势延续，可能频繁产生错误信号
缺少趋势过滤器（如均线、ADX等），在震荡市中容易频繁开平仓
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR），在不同行情下效果差异大
未检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能因点差过大而亏损
cons_en: Strategy is overly simplistic; consecutive bullish/bearish candles don't necessarily indicate trend continuation, leading to frequent false signals
Lacks a trend filter (e.g., MA, ADX), making it prone to frequent open/close cycles in ranging markets
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without considering market volatility (ATR), resulting in inconsistent performance across different market conditions
Does not check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
No spread filter, which can lead to losses in low-liquidity markets where spreads are wide
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ADX阈值），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动性
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction or ADX threshold) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to varying market volatility
Add position existence checks to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction

risk_points: 未检查同方向已有持仓，可能导致重复开仓从而过度暴露风险
固定止损止盈在不同波动率环境下可能不合适，高波动时止损可能过小
连续K线形态信号在震荡市中频繁触发，可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially causing duplicate entries and overexposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit may be inappropriate across different volatility environments; stops may be too tight in high volatility
Consecutive candle pattern signals trigger frequently in ranging markets, potentially leading to consecutive losses

It includes stop loss, take profit, and multiple money management modes via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.
